overall: Checker is clean (252/252) and neutrality is mostly good: the writer stayed away from golf for players (Tiger, Rory, Palmer, Henrik, Woods), places (Augusta) and terms (birdie, tee, greens, handicap). The main problems are (1) answer echoed in the question (Fight Club, Culture Club, MVP, ESPN, Augusta -> Augustus, plague -> Black Death, leg irons -> ankles, wraparound -> wrapping); (2) quotes or splits used only to force no-space tokens (Volkswagen's 'Golf', 'icap' x4, 'swing', 'course', 'Courses', 'Woods', night clubs, crash-course, a mid-sentence Class); verified natural routes exist for some: watercourse -> 'course', non-handicap -> 'icap', (Golfstrom ...) -> 'Golf'; (3) the same fact repeated across related tokens (horse-racing weights in 5 handicap tokens, Go stones x3, NATO H = Hotel x2, card colours, T-ball/kickoff tees, Elle Woods x2). Recommend reclassifying ' fairway' and 'Courses' as exclusive (their only items are obscure or contrived); a few items are too niche for a 2B model (PGA pin grid, VW Golf etymology). Thin tokens with fewer than 4 items are acceptable as listed; do not pad them with forced wording.
